proxy.name: proxy
proxy.help: Enable/disable communication to the proxy server in FortiGuard configuration.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable communication to the proxy server in FortiGuard configuration.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable communication to the proxy server in FortiGuard configuration.

interface.name: interface
interface.help: Interface of FortiToken Mobile push services server.

server.name: server
server.help: IPv4 address or domain name of FortiToken Mobile push services server.

server-port.name: server-port
server-port.help: Port to communicate with FortiToken Mobile push services server (1 - 65535, default = 4433).

server-cert.name: server-cert
server-cert.help: Name of the server certificate to be used for SSL.

server-ip.name: server-ip
server-ip.help: IPv4 address of FortiToken Mobile push services server (format: xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx).

status.name: status
status.help: Enable/disable the use of FortiToken Mobile push services.
